summary.intent: Execute Phase 60 ('IPNS Verification Cross-Layer Closeout') of the CipherBox GSD workflow, running 8 plans across 4 waves to harden IPNS verification to strict fail-closed behavior across Rust, TypeScript, and API layers.
summary.outcome: Waves 1 and 2 completed (5 of 6 plans confirmed done: 60-01 through 60-05, with 60-07 in-flight at transcript end). Cross-plan build/test gates passed green. Wave 3 (60-06) and Wave 4 (60-08, non-autonomous) remain.

repo: The Rust IPNS verify chokepoint was historically split: implementation lived in crates/fuse/src/verify.rs but the canonical home is crates/api-client/src/ipns.rs — sdk/fuse/desktop now share one impl after 60-01.
All 9 first-publish IPNS producers previously embedded sequence 0; correct value per protocol is 1 — producers span FUSE, desktop Tauri, sdk-core, and web.
VerifyError::Legacy variant was removed (D-04); all 9 FUSE caller arms folded to Invalid — 60-01 executor handled these as a compile necessity even though 60-04 was the declared owner.
crates/fuse/src/verify.rs was deleted in 60-04 after its implementation was relocated; nothing re-exported from it.
cipherbox-api-client gained ciborium + cipherbox-core as dependencies for CBOR Validity field parsing (EOL/expiry enforcement, D-07 Rust path).
Phase 60 plan 60-08 is explicitly non-autonomous (staging wipe + redeploy + smoke-test) and requires a human-action checkpoint before execution.
sdk-core has 251 tests including 34 ipns-specific tests; these are the authoritative cross-plan integration gate.

The gsd commit helper has a confirmed false-negative behavior: reports 'No staged files match any configured task' / commit_failed even when the commit successfully lands — must verify with git log rather than trusting the helper response.

code.finding: Was the last remaining VerifyError::Legacy reference; folded to Invalid by 60-01 executor. Stale compile-error diagnostic (E0599) was a mid-edit snapshot, not a real failure.
File deleted in 60-04 after implementation relocated to crates/api-client/src/ipns.rs. An 'unlinked-file' diagnostic post-deletion was a stale artifact, not an error.
Had stale expectation 0n for first-publish sequence; updated to 1n by 60-03 executor as a necessary cross-plan fixup from 60-02.

workflow: Sequential gsd-executor subagents on the main feature branch were chosen over worktree isolation because the harness cannot reliably recover worktree branch/path manifests for merge-back — safe tradeoff for a strict fail-closed crypto phase.

Executor subagents may commit Cargo.toml edits without committing the resulting Cargo.lock update, creating a latent --locked CI break; the orchestrator must check and commit Cargo.lock separately after each wave.
Stray SUMMARY.md footer content can be appended after the SUMMARY commit if an executor runs a self-check step post-commit; content becomes stale after subsequent plans mutate the files it describes.
Wave-level build/test gates (cargo check + full test suite) are essential for catching cross-plan conflicts that per-plan scoped checks miss.
Executor diagnostic snapshots can lag real file state — always verify with grep/cargo check rather than trusting mid-execution error messages.

friction: 60-01 executor reported a compile error (E0599: no variant Legacy for VerifyError) that was a stale mid-edit snapshot, not a real failure — required an extra orchestrator verification round-trip to confirm green.

gsd commit helper false-negative: reported 'commit_failed / No staged files match any configured task' for the Cargo.lock commit, but the commit (9fb576365) had already landed — caused uncertainty about tree state.

Wave 1 executors left two uncommitted artifacts: Cargo.lock (latent CI break) and a stale 60-01-SUMMARY.md footer claiming 'verify.rs FOUND' after 60-04 deleted it — orchestrator had to detect and clean these up manually.
The 60-04 'unlinked-file' diagnostic for verify.rs was a stale artifact that required an explicit grep + deletion check to dismiss.
open_items: Wave 3 (60-06): API publish-path verify cache for CPU cost recovery — not yet started.
Wave 4 (60-08): D-01/D-12 operational cutover (staging environment wipe + redeploy + smoke-test) — non-autonomous, requires human checkpoint and manual action.
60-07 result (cross-language verify vector regeneration) — executor was in-flight at transcript end; outcome unconfirmed.
Windows WinFSP integration site is CI-gated only (not locally testable); any seq=1 behavioral changes there are unverified until CI runs.
Phase verification and completion steps (verify-work, phase complete) have not yet run — deferred until all 8 plans are done.
